label: Accessibility Tooling
additionalInputs: Built ESLint custom rules to enforce accessibility patterns.
Integrated Playwright + axe-core pipeline to run automated accessibility scans.
Authored docs and training for accessibility checks and remediation workflows.
examples: Created ESLint plugin to catch semantic issues and enforce focus management.
Developed Playwright runner that opens flows and reports axe-core violations to CI.

label: Leadership & Delivery
additionalInputs: Led teams of 8-12 engineers across multiple releases.
Responsible for delivery planning, status reporting and stakeholder management.
Mentored engineers and conducted code/design reviews to raise quality and morale.
examples: Led migration from Angular to React for a major product and delivered on schedule.
Introduced QA and accessibility gates in the CI pipeline to reduce regressions.

label: Mentoring & Leadership
additionalInputs: Mentored mid-level engineers and conducted onboarding sessions for new hires.
Ran regular design reviews and career development conversations.
examples: Created a mentorship program pairing juniors with seniors for structured growth.
Hosted brown-bag sessions on performance and code quality best practices.

label: Agile Methodologies
additionalInputs: Practiced Scrum and Kanban; facilitated planning and retrospectives.
Introduced lightweight metrics to improve predictability and quality.
examples: Improved sprint predictability by introducing WIP limits and better grooming.
Facilitated cross-team coordination for large releases.

label: Code Quality
additionalInputs: Established linting, formatting and CI gates to maintain code standards.
Introduced PR templates and automated testing requirements for merges.
examples: Implemented ESLint and Prettier rules across monorepo to ensure consistency.
Set up CI checks that block merges on failing tests or style issues.

label: Problem Solving
additionalInputs: Experience diagnosing complex production issues and providing mitigation plans.
Skilled at breaking down large problems into testable, incremental steps.
examples: Led post-incident reviews and implemented fixes to prevent recurrence.
Designed incremental rollout strategies to mitigate risk during migrations.
